text:
samir: Heads up — we started seeing a sharp spike in 502/504 errors for hosted /v1/generate around 09:02 UTC. Traces point to our prefix cache client failing with connection errors.

samir: log sample:
```
ERROR cache.client Redis connection error: "read ECONNRESET"
cache.get prefix=customer:{cust-a}:prompt key=abc123 elapsed=18ms err=ECONNRESET
WARN gateway request_id=req_7f2a 502 upstream_error cache-fallback
```

lisa: same here, majority of hits are for prefix-cache GETs. Gateway is returning 502s when cache client doesn't respond and fallback isn't fast enough. Seeing bursts for customers using large prefix sets.

ashwin: I'm looking at kv-red-01 — connection count spiked 5x and CPU is ~92%. Opening infra investigation. Temporarily tripping circuit-breaker on prefix-cache and bumping cache timeout to 200ms.

samir: Can support toggle bypass/cache-skip for affected customers quickly? Impact list I have so far: cust-a, cust-c, cust-d. We should prod a quick Console toggle or header-based workaround.

support-bot: Created INC-9123 and paged infra oncall @ashwin.

ashwin: Mitigation applied: circuit breaker engaged for cluster kv-red-01; requests are now falling back to origin store. 5xx rate dropped from ~8% -> 1.2% in the last 3m. Keeping monitoring on for 15m.

maria: Please collect repro steps and affected customer list + SLO impact. We'll need a customer comms draft once we have RCA. :eyes:

lisa: Repro steps I used:
1) run a short load test hitting /v1/generate with header `X-Prefix-Key: customer:{cust-a}` and a high request rate
2) observe cache GET latencies climb, then cache client errors
3) gateway responds 502s

curl example:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Prefix-Key: customer:{cust-a}" -d '{"input": "hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

ashwin: Preliminary hypothesis: connection pool exhaustion after a config tweak to connection timeout yesterday. We'll capture pool metrics and review the change. Postmortem will include sizing, backoff/retry behavior, and safer rollout gating.

samir: I'll draft the support comms and include temporary workaround: add header `X-Cache-Mode: skip` or toggle 'skip cache' in the Console per-customer. Thanks all.
